description: A medium-sized laughingthrush of open montane forest (fir, birch, oak) with dense rhododendron and bamboo or bushes, 1,800–2,400 m, descending in winter. Olive and buffy with a black stripe down the centre of the throat, a broad pale moustachial area, a black tail with a broad grey subterminal band and white tip, and a rufous belly and vent. Noisy parties; short altitudinal shifts outside the breeding season.
